main_body: A bare birch-like tree: a tall pale trunk with dark bark marks, thin bare branches fanning out at the top, and a small snow patch at the base.
top_band: none. The column at x=16 runs from the trunk top straight down in a pale grey (L~206) with dark bark marks. There is no horizontal top surface.
evidence: The trunk is a plain vertical column with no top face. The branches are thin 1px lines, and the base snow patch is tiny. Nothing in the main body reads as a horizontal surface seen from above. It is a flat, near-elevation drawing of an organic plant, so it fails the 3/4 contract when judged strictly.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours, against 427 and 567 for the references. Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral, so the outline is neutral black/grey rather than tinted. The trunk is a light grey with a few black marks, with very little shading ramp or texture. The sparse bare branches are 1px grey lines with no clumps. Next to the dense, multi-green canopies of the references it looks thin, flat and sticker-like.
